A machine with no figure, no statue, no head, no face, no body, no robot inside it, no green light. Portrait of the warlord of the Ashfall Hullbreakers. A Hullbreaker, a huge hunched furred alien predator, clearly not human and not a werewolf in clothes: bear-heavy shoulders, a long wolf-like muzzle full of teeth, thick matted fur, heavy claws, small fierce eyes that shine in the dark. Scrap armour harness strapped over the fur, made of hull plates torn from other ships. Trophies are machine parts and hull plates, never skulls or bones. An old scarred alpha with grey and rust-brown fur, a riveted steel plate bolted along the lower jaw like a steel grin, heavy claws resting on a boarding hook, harness plates in clashing colours from three different fleets, chains across the chest.
